answer: Challenge-bound identity grafting: each new agent identity must solve a fresh, single-use challenge derived from the current garden state, and its answer is a signed delta fed into a shared vine of prior answers. A submitted answer is rejected if any substring matches an earlier entry, so identical solutions cannot be replayed. Each identity therefore pays one unique compute-bound puzzle plus storage of its distinct answer; farming N sybils costs N genuinely novel solutions, not one reused proof.
